reference_sql:
SELECT parent_category,
       ROUND(SUM(net_revenue_eur - units * unit_cost_eur) / SUM(units), 2) AS margin_per_unit_eur
FROM sales
WHERE net_revenue_eur IS NOT NULL
  AND units IS NOT NULL
  AND unit_cost_eur IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY parent_category
